Features groups: what changes

Drawn on NIST STC 10 with its .ipt (the demo's pair), Milling, Aluminum 6061. Words and numbers are copied from the built S1 screen on the same data; the model pictures are the built viewer.

  • Today (S1, built): Threads, Hole features and Fillets and chamfers are three boxes that each scroll inside the Features list (picture below).
  • Frames 1 and 2 are drawn full length so the groups show; on screen the list scrolls as one inside the 900 px window, as frame 3 shows.
  • Proposed: under the Issues rows, one line "From <the .ipt>", then one row per group: name, count and its tally in the approved words (MATCHED, DISAGREES, NOT MAPPED). Tap a row to open it in place; no box scrolls inside another, the step's list scrolls as one.
  • An opened group shows today's rows (D-036, D-040, D-043), unchanged; tapping a row still selects its hole or faces on the model. Its intro line drops the "From <.ipt>: n matched, n disagree, n not mapped" part, which the group row now shows, and keeps the rest ("Tap a thread to show its hole."; for Hole features "11 Hole features in the browser, 9 read." stays).
  • A group opens by itself when it did before: Threads when the .ipt has threads; Hole features and Fillets and chamfers when one disagrees or isn't mapped. On STC 10 that opens all three; frame 1 shows them folded to show the layout.
  • The groups show under every chip (Issues, Passed, All). With no .ipt there are no groups (frame r3-features, unchanged). An .ipt with none of a kind keeps its row: "Threads 0", opening to "No threads in this .ipt."
  • Also for Morgan's eye: the opened row's detail labels its advice "Fix" on a Fix row and "Suggestion" on a Review row (the round 3 frame showed "Fix" only, on a Fix row).
